git.note: Release CLI built from the working tree that became cda3089 (additive-only change); numerical path unchanged from abb544a.

scope: Audit of the authenticated read path, an additive opt-in manifest range-verification primitive with adversarial tests, Rust regressions, and a genuine Qwen2.5-7B no-regression + teacher-forced parity run. NOT a multi-reader before/after 7B wall-clock benchmark: the new primitive is intentionally not wired into the default decoder (see limitations).

environment.filesystem: ext4 (model under /home); repo on /mnt/e (NTFS via WSL)
environment.hashing_note: sha2 selects the x86 SHA-NI backend at runtime via cpufeatures; re-hash is already hardware-accelerated. No untapped SHA-NI optimization.

implementation.semantics: content-addressed: Ok(true)=full aligned block matches trusted manifest (no source I/O); Ok(false)=not a full aligned block (caller falls back to mutable-source re-read path); Err=full aligned block that does not match manifest (fail closed).
implementation.trust_root: per-block SHA-256 list anchored to the verified whole-file digest at authenticate_model time (process-memory TCB).

regressions.preserved_guarantee: The two existing consumption-time mutation-detection tests still pass unchanged; the default verify_staged_range_cancellable semantics are untouched.

manifest_verification_effect.measured_by: unit tests on an authenticated 8-byte-chunk fixture
manifest_verification_effect.after_in_place_mutation: authentic staged bytes still verify via manifest with 0 source bytes; default re-read path reports 'block changed'
manifest_verification_effect.partial_range_fallback: routes through default path and does read the source (source_bytes_read increases)

inference_7b.command: taskset -c 0,1 llmbridge chat <model> --prompt 'The capital of France is' --max-tokens 2 --ctx 128 --threads 2 --backend streamed --metrics --sha256 <sha> --address-space-mb 2048 --workspace-mb 48
inference_7b.note: 2-token authenticated streamed run on the freshly built binary; same primary path as abb544a (the new primitive is not on this path). Confirms no regression and that the CLI builds from the changed source.

parity_7b.command: taskset -c 0,1 llmbridge logit-diff <model> --prompt 'The capital of France is' --ctx 128 --threads 2 --top-k 10 --workspace-mb 48
parity_7b.note: Bit-identical to the pre-change binary's logit-diff, confirming the additive change does not alter numerical execution.

security_posture.per_block_manifest: unchanged; now also usable for content-addressed range verification
security_posture.source_identity_and_mutation_detection: unchanged on the default path (tests pass)
security_posture.bounded_memory: unchanged; primitive operates on bounded in-memory staged bytes, no new allocation arena

limitations: The opt-in manifest verification primitive is NOT wired into the default 7B decode path (by design: it changes consumption-time mutation-detection semantics). It therefore yields no end-to-end 7B wall-clock delta by itself; a production immutable-snapshot decode mode plus a multi-reader before/after 7B benchmark is remaining work.

Under bounded memory + an untrusted local writer, the primary per-token weight re-read and re-hash are intrinsic and were not (and cannot safely be) eliminated; this is a documented architectural result, not a pending task.
Resident-backend generated text remains host-RAM blocked on this 6.7 GiB host; parity logits are obtained via the mmap logit-diff path.
Only the 2048 MiB address-space setting was exercised this session (the 2048/1024/512/256 ladder was validated on 2026-11-24 in the prior evidence and the primary path is unchanged).
WSL2, not bare metal; repo on NTFS via /mnt/e.
classification: COMPLETE (evidence-backed) for: git checkpoint sync, read-path audit, snapshot trust boundary, the implemented+tested opt-in manifest range-verification primitive, regressions, and 7B no-regression + parity. PARTIALLY COMPLETE for the broader optimization objective: the safe win is implemented as an opt-in building block; eliminating the primary streamed re-read/re-hash is a documented blocker under the stated constraints.
